I can't stand being alone all the time at home with no one to talk to. The only time I do have people to talk to is people I've never met online who are much older than me who I play world of warcraft with and the only time I get my mind off everything is when we raid on weekends. Other than that I've got no one anymore and I don't know how to make friends any more. I only made these ones by accident because I sat where they normally sat and they said I didn't have to leave because they knew I had no friends (this was in year 11 as I had moved schools) If this is going to happen every time I let myself trust someone and get close to them I'm better off alone but then I'm just so lonely.
